title: Hyprune world 0.9: characters, paths, seats and keepClear; object assets from package directories and libraries; 0.8 objects otherwise

objectAssets.description: Object assets (RFC-0004 world 0.8, RFC-0011 world 0.9): exactly one source each, an inline package glTF, a package object directory or a library object.

objects.description: Placed instances of objectAssets (RFC-0004 world 0.8, RFC-0011 world 0.9). pose is required unless path is set and forbidden with it; at most 16 character instances.

path.description: A paths[] slug with use route (characters only); pose is omitted.

reverse.description: Only with path: start walking towards decreasing arc length.

seat.description: Characters without path: sits there permanently.

accent.description: Characters only: linear RGB for the accent material.

interactions.description: Characters only; replaces the asset's list. Ids unique per list.

paths.description: Authored paths (RFC-0011 Paths): at most 64, 1,024 points in total.

seats.description: World seat anchors (RFC-0011 Seats and sitting).

keepClear.description: Boxes that objects may not block and route stops avoid.

animation.description: A world 0.8 declarative node animation (spin, orbit or bob).

interaction.description: Asset-level character interaction: only say and panel, which reference nothing in a world.

seatAnchor.description: Where the sitter's root stands at the start of sit (asset space), facing yaw degrees about +Y from +Z. perch, lean and ground uses are reserved.

collidable.description: The 0.8 static collision proxy: a mesh node, not animated, not in an animated subtree.

movable.description: Offered for user placement. Defaults: surfaces ["floor"], upright true for floor and ceiling, scale [1, 1].

walk.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

idle.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

additionalProperties.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

character.description: RFC-0010 character: clips with measured values (walk and idle required), height and radius in metres.

mount.description: Reserved (RFC-0011 P4): a prop that holds a window. Rejected in world format 0.9.

machine.description: Reserved for RFC-0013 (live objects). Rejected in world format 0.9.

interactive.description: Reserved (RFC-0011 P4): use actions on ordinary objects. Rejected in world format 0.9.

mover.description: World format 0.10 (RFC-0011 P3). Rejected in world format 0.9.

objectTraits.description: Inline object asset traits (object.json 0.9 shapes). Unknown or reserved names reject the world.

objectSlots.description: Inline object asset slots (object.json 0.9 shapes): authored parts that RFC-0013 drives. Validated and inert in 0.9.

oneOf.description: Walk the player along a route path (the slug of a paths[] entry with use route).

instanceInteraction.description: Instance-level character interaction: say, waypoint (zone, position, anchor or object), guide (a route path) or panel. travel and quest are reserved and rejected in world 0.9.

seatRef.description: A world seats[] id, <objectId>/<anchorId> or <objectId> (any free anchor of a seat object).

pathPoint.description: The segment type arriving at this point; an open path ignores its first point's type, a closed path uses it for the closing segment.

pathStop.description: A stop at a point index (one per point, below the point count): seconds (default 3) and at most one of clip, face or seat. Track stops take only point and seconds; generic paths have no stops.

path.description: An authored path (RFC-0011 Paths). use defaults to generic, closed to false.

worldSeat.description: A world-space seat anchor: pose is where the sitter's root stands at the start of sit, facing the pose's +Z; height is the seat surface above it; approach (default 0.6 m) the free floor in front.

keepClearBox.description: An axis-aligned box objects may not block (doorways, stairs, passages); min below max on every axis.

inlineObjectAsset.description: A package glTF asset: animations is shorthand for traits.decorative.animations and collision for traits.collidable (giving both forms of one is invalid).

dirObjectAsset.description: A package object directory (no trailing slash) holding object.json (object format at most the world's) and its scene.

library.description: An installed shared object library, <reverse-domain id>@<semver>, resolved exactly.

libraryObjectAsset.description: An object of an installed library; a missing library fails activation.
